title: Business Development Intern - Cardio Program (H/F)
desc:
6-month internship · Start date: March 2027 · On-site, Issy-les-Moulineaux
About Withings Health Solutions
Withings Health Solutions is the B2B division of Withings, dedicated to developing connected health solutions for professional use. We partner with healthcare providers, digital health companies and other organizations to deploy preventive and chronic care programs powered by connected medical devices and real-world data.

About the Cardio Program
Hypertension affects one in three adults, and many patients aren’t diagnosed or don’t have it under control. Atrial fibrillation is often caught late. Cardiologists see the patients who benefit most from monitoring at home, but they have very little reliable data between consultations.
The Cardio Program helps independent cardiologists in France recommend Withings medical devices to their patients. Physicians get better data to make consultations more efficient and fine-tune treatment. Patients get simple tools to follow their condition and stay on their treatment. Over the past months, we have built the program’s foundations: the value proposition, the physician journey, the outreach materials and the landing page. We now need to scale it.

Role Overview
As Business Development Intern, you will drive adoption of the Cardio Program among cardiologists in France. You will find and approach practices, meet physicians, present the program, and support them after they join.
This is a field-facing, results-driven role with high visibility. You will work closely with the marketing, sales and medical teams, and your feedback will shape how the program evolves.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify and prioritize target cardiologists and practices across France
• Run outreach by phone, email and in person, from the first contact to a scheduled meeting
• Present the Cardio Program to cardiologists, including product demos, in person or remotely
• Onboard new cardiologists and follow up with them so they actively recommend our solutions to patients
• Manage your pipeline in Salesforce and report on key metrics (contacts, meetings, active physicians)
• Collect field feedback and share it with the team to refine messaging, materials and the outreach process
• Attend cardiology events from time to time to meet cardiologists in person
• Contribute to recommendations on how to scale the program, such as new channels, partnerships or regions
Requirements

• Business school, engineering school or health-related studies; interest in healthcare and medical innovation
• Strong appetite for business development: you enjoy prospecting, picking up the phone and meeting people
• Confident, clear communicator, comfortable with healthcare professionals
• Resilient, organized and results-oriented, able to manage a pipeline autonomously
• Experience with a CRM (ideally Salesforce) is a plus
• Based in Paris area; willing to travel occasionally within France
• Native or fluent French required; professional English
Benefits

Joining the Withings adventure means:

• Becoming part of one of the pioneers and global leaders in connected health, with multiple CES Innovation Awards
• Taking ownership of a growth lever with direct, measurable business impact
• Gaining hands-on business development experience with healthcare professionals
• Joining an international company, member of the French Tech 120, with teams in Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong Kong and Shenzhen
• Working with passionate colleagues and celebrating our successes together

All applications are reviewed regardless of ethnic origin, beliefs, religion, gender, sexual orientation, or health status. Withings is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for all candidates, and only authorized individuals (HR and Management) will have access to your application information.

title: Intern, Data Labeler (Spanish Speaker) - (Global Discovery, Consumer)
desc:
Company Description
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description
Learning nonstop. Innovation on tap. As an Intern, Data Labeler, you’ll label and review the data behind the search and recommendation systems that power brands like foodpanda, Glovo, PedidosYa and talabat. Every accurate annotation helps millions of customers find what they’re looking for, faster.
At the center of our marketplace is the Discovery organization. This team is currently building Search, Recommendation, and intent collection systems to power our brands like Foodpanda, Glovo, Pedidos Ya, Talabat - serving millions of requests every day. The systems we build are critical for our online marketplaces with high availability and performance requirements and drive meaningful commercial value. They require crafting control loops through data, machine learning, and online serving systems to serve millions of consumers worldwide.
At Delivery Hero, you’ll shape the global consumer experience for millions of users. Your work will have a direct impact on how we attract and retain customers, creating data-driven, personalized interactions that keep them coming back. As part of our Consumer Team, you’ll enhance customer satisfaction and drive global growth and profitability through innovative projects.

• Label and annotate images, text, audio and video accurately.
• Keep data quality and consistency high by following established labeling guidelines, directly shaping users’ search experience.
• Work with the team to identify and resolve labeling discrepancies.
• Share feedback on labeling guidelines and suggest improvements.

Qualifications
• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field (e.g. Business, Finance, Accounting or Engineering), or a recent graduate.
• Comfortable working with large volumes of data and documents.
• Fluency in written and spoken English and Spanish.
• Availability of 20 hours per week for 6 months.
Nice to have

• Interest in machine learning concepts.
• Experience with data labeling tools.

Additional Information
Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

• Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week

• We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service

• We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.

• Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.

• Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan

• The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.

• Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

• Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Heads up: exact benefits may look a little different for intern, working student, fixed-term, and part-time roles.
Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!
We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.
We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.
You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

title: Intern, Corporate Governance (6 Months)
desc:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a motivated intern to support the Executive Office and Corporate Governance Team at N26 for 6 months. The Executive Office plays a key role in coordinating cross-functional work between C-level executives, ensuring efficiency in strategic planning and execution. As an Intern, Corporate Governance Team, you will gain hands-on experience in administrative support, project coordination, stakeholder management, and executive operations, making this an excellent opportunity to develop critical business and organizational skills in a fast-paced environment.

In this role you will:

• Administrative & Financial Support: Assist in processing expense reports, purchase orders, and managing incoming correspondence for the Executive Office.

• Travel & Logistics Coordination: Support travel arrangements, including research and bookings for flights, hotels, and team activities.

• Meeting & Event Preparation: Prepare meeting materials, presentations, and agendas for high-level executive sessions.

• Project Coordination: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to track deadlines, follow up on deliverables, and support Executive Office initiatives.

• Stakeholder & Guest Management: Act as a liaison between the Executive Office, internal teams, and external visitors to facilitate seamless communication and hospitality.

• Ad-Hoc Support: Assist with special projects and additional tasks as required by the Executive Office team.

What You Need to Be Successful:

• Recently completed a Degree or Masters in Business, Finance, Law, Economics, Management, Politics, or a related field.

• Excellent communication skills in English (and German beneficial).

• Highly organised, detail-oriented, and adaptable to a dynamic work environment.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) is an advantage.

• A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Based in Berlin or willing to relocate for the duration of the internship.

What’s in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors

• Employee benefits include discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language courses, public transportation and more.

• A Premium N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Varying vacation days depending on your location of work and duration of your internship.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and backgrounds.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

Discover more about Diversity & Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

title: Workingstudent B2C SEO & AI Search (x/f/m)
desc:
Doctolib is looking for you to join our Patient Marketing team in Berlin as a Working Student in B2C SEO and AI Search (x/f/m)

Patient Marketing helps Doctolib reach patients in Germany with relevant, useful content and strengthen access to healthcare. In this role, you will support content discoverability, content quality, conversion, data analysis, and AI-supported search initiatives.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a working student in B2C SEO and AI Search, you will support us in the following areas:

 - Content SEO, CMS and editing: support content strategies, maintain WordPress content, and optimize copy for patients and search

 - Keyword research, competitor analysis, and reporting: analyze the German health market and monitor SEO performance using tools such as Google Search Console and Semrush

 - AI search and cross-functional support: explore generative-AI-supported SEO work and collaborate with B2C Marketing and Patient Content


WORKING WITH US, YOU WILL LEARN:

 - How SEO and AI search are applied in a fast-growing health-tech company

 - Practical experience in content optimization, CMS workflows, and SEO analytics

 - How to collaborate across local and international marketing teams


WHO YOU ARE 

If you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.


YOU COULD BE OUR NEXT TEAM MATE IF YOU:

 - Are studying marketing, media, communications, journalism, business administration, or a similar field, can work up to 20 hours per week during the semester, and have excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Speak German C2 and English C1 level; French or Italian is a plus

 - Are familiar with a CMS such as WordPress and with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT


NOW, IT WOULD BE FANTASTIC IF YOU:

 - Have first experience in SEO or content marketing and with tools such as Google Search Console or Keyword Planner

 - Have initial experience with Canva or an interest in translation and generative AI

 - Have previous experience in marketing, communications, journalism, editorial work, publishing, or healthcare


WHAT WE OFFER 

 - A structured and personalized onboarding program through our Doctolib Academy, as well as a wide range of in-house training opportunities

 - A flexible working model that allows for hybrid and office-based work

 - A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib, or reimbursement of your semester ticket

 - 28 vacation days per year (calculated pro rata according to your working schedule)

 - The opportunity to work from EU countries or the UK for up to 10 days per year (eligible after 6 months)

 - Company health insurance with many additional benefits and subsidies (eligible after 6 months)

 - Regular breakfast in the office and subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping

 - A subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club


THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - First Interview with the Hiring Manager 

 - Case study Interview 


JOB DETAILS

 - Working Student in part-time: up to 20 hours per week 

 - Duration: 12 months

 - Workplace: Berlin

 - Salary: €15 gross/hour - (€16 gross/hour from January 2027)

 - Start date:  November 2026

 - Hybrid setup with 2 office days per week

 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. 

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

title: Working Student - IT Asset & Stock Management (x/f/m)
desc:
WORKING STUDENT – IT ASSET & STOCK MANAGEMENT (X/F/M) – BERLIN


JOIN OUR MISSION, JOIN DOCTOLIB!

Doctolib is looking for you as a Working Student in IT Asset & Stock Management to support our IT team at our office in Berlin.

To give the best experience to Doctolibers and support Doctolib’s growth, you will help manage our IT stock and asset base, including laptops, smartphones and accessories. Reporting to the IT team, you will own the reliability of our hardware inventory and contribute to day-to-day on-site support in an international environment across Germany, France, Italy and the Netherlands.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Working Student, you will support us in the following areas:

IT stock and asset management — approximately 70%

 - Manage the site’s IT stock, including receiving, checking, labelling and storing laptops, smartphones and accessories

 - Keep the inventory up to date in our asset management tool and ensure the accuracy of serial numbers, assignments and statuses

 - Follow the full equipment lifecycle, including assignment, return, loan, vendor repair, refurbishment and recycling

 - Run periodic physical inventories and consistency checks between physical stock and the asset management tool

 - Monitor stock levels, flag replenishment thresholds and contribute to supplier orders

 - Prepare devices, including mobile device management enrolment, standard configuration and accessory kits

 - Propose improvements to stock processes, documentation, automation and key performance indicators

On-site support — approximately 30%

 - Support onboarding and offboarding by preparing, handing over and recovering equipment for joiners and leavers

 - Run the Berlin IT Corner as a physical point of contact for Doctolibers

 - Manage meeting room hardware by testing, updating and replacing equipment

 - Handle level 1 requests and incidents, including basic diagnosis and application access, and escalate to level 2 when needed

 - Identify recurring requests and contribute to continuous improvement


WORKING WITH US, YOU WILL LEARN:

 - How to manage the full lifecycle of IT hardware and maintain reliable asset data

 - How on-site IT support contributes to a smooth employee experience

 - How to identify opportunities to improve operational processes through documentation, automation and performance indicators


WHO YOU ARE

If you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.


YOU COULD BE OUR NEXT TEAM MATE IF YOU:

 - You are enrolled full-time at a university, ideally studying IT Systems Management, IT Management, Applied IT or a related field

 - You are rigorous, organised and service-oriented, with good interpersonal skills

 - You are comfortable working with Windows, macOS, iOS and Android, and can prioritise tasks while working autonomously and as part of a team

 - You are fluent in German and English

 - You are able to work on site in Berlin and handle equipment weighing up to 25 kg


NOW, IT WOULD BE FANTASTIC IF YOU:

 - You have had a first exposure to an IT service management or mobile device management tool


WHAT WE OFFER

 - A structured and personalized onboarding program through our Doctolib Academy, as well as a wide range of in-house training opportunities

 - A flexible working model that allows for hybrid and office-based work

 - A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib, or reimbursement of your semester ticket

 - 28 vacation days per year (calculated pro rata according to your working schedule)

 - The opportunity to work from abroad for up to 10 days per year (eligible after 6 months)

 - Company health insurance with many additional benefits and subsidies (eligible after 6 months)

 - Regular breakfast in the office and subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping

 - A subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club


THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Interview with a team mate

 - Interview with your future Manager


JOB DETAILS

 - Working Student in part-time, up to 20 hours per week during the semester and up to 40 hours per week during semester breaks

 - Duration: 6 months, renewable

 - Workplace: Berlin, Germany

 - Start date: At the earliest opportunity

 - Salary: 15 €/h

 - On-site role due to the physical handling of equipment

 - Flexible working hours adapted to your class schedule

 - A valid certificate of enrolment is required
